title: The sandbox dispatch door carries no prompt: a cloud profile's role prompt never reaches the worker container
body: Deciding where collect lives exposed a second gap beside the known one about models (b7e18ccf): the door's start body carries role, write_ref, base_ref, title and base_sha but no prompt, so the prompt file a cloud profile names (profiles-cloudflare-sandbox/implement-tick.md etc.) is validated, digested into provenance, and never delivered — the worker container runs the pinned image's own ticks-style prompt built by worker.sh from the tick record. Two report contracts now coexist unreconciled: the profile prompt tells the agent to write runs/<run>/<tick>/RESULT-<tick>.md (excluded from git), while the container guarantees RESULT-<tick>.md at the branch root via its own entrypoint commit; a run works only because worker.sh writes a fallback report when its root file is absent. A tick should either carry the role prompt through the door or record deliberately that the image's prompt is the cloud worker's contract.
